title: Port Engine Propulsion System Overhaul — Blue Octopus
description: Complete teardown and rebuild of the port-side diesel propulsion system. Owner reports excessive vibration above 2,200 RPM and irregular fuel consumption. Suspected crankshaft bearing wear on cylinders 3 and 4.

title: Main Electrical Panel Fault — Golden Tide
description: Intermittent power loss to nav instruments and cabin lighting. Circuit breaker tripping repeatedly on port-side panel. Full electrical diagnostic and panel inspection required.

title: Integrated Navigation System Upgrade — Marmara Pearl
description: Chartplotter, AIS transponder and VHF integration. Old Garmin unit to be replaced with Raymarine Axiom Pro 16. Radar overlay calibration required after installation.

title: Annual Hull Maintenance and Antifouling — Göcek Breeze
description: Full hull haul-out for blasting, antifouling application and topcoat finish. Running gear to be inspected and zincs replaced. Hempel Classic topcoat as per owner specification.

title: Standing Rigging Inspection and Service — CargoDry Demo Boat
description: Full standing rigging inspection. Shrouds, forestay and backstay to be checked for fatigue and corrosion. Swageless terminals to be re-set. Mast head fitting inspection included.

title: Propulsion Shaft and Bearing Repair — Kalamış Runner
description: Provider invoiced 47 hours of labour against an agreed maximum scope of 30 hours. Propeller shaft alignment and bearing replacement was the agreed scope. Owner disputes the additional hours billed without prior authorisation.

title: Saloon Upholstery Replacement — Bodrum Star
description: Saloon settee and pilot berth upholstery replacement. Current vinyl is cracked and mildew-stained. Owner prefers marine-grade cream Sunbrella fabric. Foam core replacement also required.

title: Annual Safety Equipment Inspection — Aegean Wind
description: Full safety equipment audit: EPIRB, life raft, flares, fire extinguishers and life jackets. EPIRB registration renewal and life raft repack certificate required.

title: Freshwater System Pressure Fault — Blue Octopus
description: Freshwater pump losing pressure intermittently. Accumulator tank possibly waterlogged. Full plumbing check including hot water calorifier and all through-hulls.
cancelReason: Owner decided to handle internally with yard crew.

title: Windlass Motor and Gearbox Overhaul — Golden Tide
description: Electric windlass seized during anchoring. Motor brushes worn and gearbox showing metal debris in oil. Full overhaul or replacement of Maxwell HRC windlass unit required.
